BiblicalUsage: Samgar-Nebo was a prince of the king of Babylon who entered Jerusalem and sat in the middle gate when the city fell. His name is one of the Babylonian officers listed at the moment Judah's kingdom ended.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God lets us see the faces of judgment, and Samgar-Nebo stands in the gate as a reminder that the fall of Jerusalem really happened.
